messages.author: eb9a4188a4906706
messages.subject: Piechart
parts:
Hi Nick

I have a question regarding the piechart, is there a way in BioGeoBears to plot only the most probable ancestral states on the piecharts plus the less probable states combined in just one color? Let me know if there is a way in BioGeoBears, thanks!

messages.author: 665b3d97beb30882
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Piechart
parts:
Hi -- right now you would have to do this manually, it
wouldn't be very hard though -- just take the matrix of
probabilities, add an "other" column, convert all the lower
probabilities to 0 and add them to the other column, then
plot with a modified version of the plot_BioGeoBEARS_results
function. You can see the code for plot_BioGeoBEARS_results
by typing "plot_BioGeoBEARS_results" and hitting enter. It's
just using basic APE plot stuff mostly, with a tweak to plot
at corners also.

Cheers,
Nick
